the majority of CVD drugs evaluated in this study do not appear to alter breast cancer outcomes, but ACEI use was associated with an increased risk of a second primary breast cancer, and BB use was associated with increased risk of recurrence.

the majority of cardiovascular medication use does not appear to increase risk of breast cancer recurrence or second primary, but ACEI may increase the risk of a second primary breast cancer and BB may increase the risk for a breast cancer recurrence.   1
